meta.description: Atoll Rent A Car offers Northern Cyprus car rental at the lowest guaranteed prices. Car rentals starting from as low as £30 in North Cyprus. Kyrenia office, Ercan, Larnaca and Paphos airports.

home.fleetLead: From city hatchbacks to 7-seaters and Land Rovers. Every car has air conditioning.
home.factsTitle: Good to know before you book
home.fact1: Alsancak, Çatalköy, Ozanköy, Karmi and Kyrenia town: we bring the car to you at no charge.
home.fact2: Add South Cyprus cover for £50 per rental and cross at any checkpoint.
home.fact3: Landing in the south? Collect the car at Larnaca or Paphos airport.
home.fact4: Our car hire rates include a full 24-hour day, unlimited mileage, oil and greasing, safety belts in all cars and a change of car in case of mechanical breakdown. Damage excess is fixed at 500 euros.
home.step1: Choose where and when. You see straight away which cars are free and the full price.
home.step2: We hold the car for you for 15 minutes while you add extras like a baby seat or South Cyprus cover.
home.step3: Pay by cash when you take delivery of the car, or by card through our secure online system.
home.ctaLead: Our Kyrenia team answers on WhatsApp, usually within minutes during office hours.
home.fact5: All international and national licences are accepted. The minimum age for car hire in Northern Cyprus is 25.
home.fact6: A 10% cancellation fee applies to bookings cancelled less than 48 hours before the agreed pick-up time.
home.estate: Over the years the main reason to buying property in North Cyprus was the great sunny weather, low cost living, cheap properties, low crime and fresh foods. North Cyprus properties is not only promising to be a good investment for investors but also becoming a popular destination to relocate and retire.
